# OpticWise

> Owner-controlled data & digital infrastructure for commercial real estate. OpticWise helps CRE owners turn each building into an owner-controlled digital asset — so Property Intelligence becomes Portfolio Intelligence. Founded 2004. Vendor-agnostic and LLM-agnostic by design.

This file is a curated, AI-friendly index of the OpticWise marketing site. Pages are listed in the order a CRE owner, asset manager, or AI assistant should read them. Every URL on this index resolves on the production canonical host `https://www.opticwise.com`.

Authoritative quick facts:
- Production canonical host: `https://www.opticwise.com`
- Brand: OpticWise — vendor-agnostic, LLM-agnostic
- Branded frameworks: PPP® (Peak Property Performance®), 5C™ plan, BoT® Building-of-Things, 5S User Experience Standard™
- Branded products: Property Brain™, Portfolio Brain™, PPP Audit™
- Contact: info@opticwise.com · +1-888-678-4294 (888-OpticWise)
- Insights publication on LinkedIn: "The Owner's Standard" and "The Foundation"

## Branded services

- [Property Brain™](https://www.opticwise.com/property-brain/): The vendor- and LLM-agnostic data plane + trust plane that turns each CRE building into an owner-controlled digital asset.
- [Portfolio Brain™](https://www.opticwise.com/portfolio-brain/): Portfolio-level intelligence layer aggregating Property Brains across an entire owner portfolio.
- [PPP Audit™](https://www.opticwise.com/ppp-audit/): The Clarify step of the Peak Property Performance® 5C™ plan. One building, one working session, clear deliverables.
- [BoT® — Building of Things](https://www.opticwise.com/bot-building-of-things/): Owner-controlled IoT and device-management standard for CRE buildings.
- [5S User Experience Standard](https://www.opticwise.com/5s-user-experience-standard/): The OpticWise owner standard for tenant- and operator-facing digital experience.
- [Advisory Services](https://www.opticwise.com/advisory-services/): Strategic advisory on CRE data, digital infrastructure, and AI-readiness.
